basic_info.description: Residence 410 is one of the largest two-bedroom homes in the Knox building, featuring an expansive open floor plan filled with natural light from oversized south-facing windows.  The contemporary kitchen, anchored by a striking white quartz island, is perfect for those who love to cook or entertain.   Additional highlights include modern window coverings, Nest air conditioning, in-unit washer and dryer, and excellent storage including a walk-in closet, deeded storage unit, bike storage & a secure garage parking space.  Building amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center, media room, interior courtyard with fire pits and BBQ area, ButterflyMX intercom, package room, and a welcoming lobby attendant.  Located just a short walk from the 22nd Street Caltrain Station, Muni T-Third, and multiple bus lines (22, 48), commuting to downtown S.F, SoMa, or Silicon Valley is seamless. With a walk score of 91, the neighborhood is ideal for pedestrians and cyclists alike.  The Dogpatch-Potrero corridor is not only beloved for its sunny microclimate & community charm but is also at the forefront of SF's AI and innovation boom. Experience the best of San Francisco's next chapterKnox Unit 410 is your front-row seat to urban comfort, creativity, and connectivity.
